chatHello: Hi! I can tell you about this card, its technologies, or point you to the repository. I’m a local demo assistant.
chatTechKnown: The repository metadata lists: {items}. Open GitHub for the latest details.

chatRepoAnswer: The code and current details are on GitHub. The repository button is right here.
chatContactAnswer: Jules is a computer science student. His LinkedIn and email links still need to be added to the profile.
chatFallback: I’m a local demo assistant, with answers limited to information on this page. Try asking about the technologies, description, or GitHub repository.
chatSendError: Your message could not be sent. Please try again.
matchesEmpty: Your favourites will show up here.
